description: This file contains validation functions for signer names and cluster trust bundle names within the Kubernetes project, including syntax validation and prefix enforcement.

methods.name: IsKubernetesSignerName
methods.description: Checks if the signerName is reserved by the Kubernetes project, specifically if the hostname is 'kubernetes.io' or ends with '.kubernetes.io'.

methods.name: ValidateSignerName
methods.description: Validates that signerName is syntactically correct, of the form 'domain.com/resource', with length and label constraints.

methods.name: ValidateClusterTrustBundleName
methods.description: Returns a function that validates the name of a ClusterTrustBundle, ensuring proper prefix based on signerName and DNS subdomain rules.

methods.name: extractSignerNameFromClusterTrustBundleName
methods.description: Extracts the signerName from a ClusterTrustBundle name if it follows the expected colon-separated format.
